title: Research: dual-scale Boolean Norm inventory for precision-blind a=(4,1) (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Answers open question 1 of just-open [#4053](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4053): does the Norm∘F_a Boolean inventory remain complete for the precision-blind family `a=(1+p^{w-1},1)` on `(Z/p^w Z)^2` **without enlarging the two-coordinate scale support**?

**Shared-factor Norm: No.** Dual-scale on the same support: **Yes.**

On the unchanged PR2808 Boolean origin-plane fixture at `q=3`, `w=2` (`M=9`, `n=2`, `a=(4,1)`, volume **6561**, **13** planes):

- Raw weighted callee attains only **729/6561** agreements with interchange `J`.
- The single shared-factor Norm pattern of #4053 is **obstructed**: no `s` with `4s≡1` and `s²≡1 (mod 9)`.
- Dual asymmetric scales `(s_{H1},s_{D0})=(7,4)` on the **same** coordinates `(H'_1,D'_0)` realize `F_{(4,7)}` with `(P')²=I`, and the ordinary wrapper attains **6561/6561**.

Paid inventory:

| Line item | Count |
|---|---:|
| scale | **341172** |
| inverse | **341172** |
| source_access | **170586** |
| restoration | **170638** |
| frame_copy (pad_in + pad_out + callee) | **511758** |

Algebraic remap controls and one live Boolean shared-`(2,2)` control stay imperfect. **No new kappa.** Selected κ stays `0.001672660197076918`. Does not claim a supplier saving or selected GL64 admission.

## Task and overlap

- Package: `research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice/`
- Tip: `a8aee53e21055c29d09299e74c71b995d54ec9b8`
- Base: `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`
- Scope: **refined** — answers #4053 OQ1 with single-factor obstruction + dual-scale same-support inventory

Closest prior: [#4053](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4053); [#2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950); PR2808 Boolean fixture. Soft overlap vs #4053 is high on harness (~0.75–0.95) but the load-bearing delta is the obstruction + dual `(7,4)` algebra, not a `(3,2,(2,1))` meter reprint.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PRECISION_BLIND_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE q=3 w=2 a=(4,1) raw_agreements=729/6561 normalized_agreements=6561/6561 dual_scales=(7,4) target=(4,7) scale=341172 inverse=341172 source_access=170586 restoration=170638 frame_copy=511758 single_factor_obstructed no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_PRECISION_BLIND_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE raw=729/6561 normalized=6561/6561 dual_scales=(7,4) scale=341172 inverse=341172 source_access=170586 restoration=170638 frame_copy=511758 single_factor_obstructed no_new_kappa
PASS_PRECISION_BLIND_BOOLEAN_NORM_INVOICE_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/precision-blind-boolean-norm-invoice outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`. Note: full Boolean verify is slow (minutes).

## Open next questions / limitations

- Most wrong-scale checks are algebraic remaps plus one live shared-`(2,2)` Boolean control (package-budget thinning vs #4053’s two live wrong-scales).
- Pad_in/out frame_copy remain closed-form from pinned `padding.complete` (`added=0`), same discipline as #4053.
